lines.cap: Every year, fifteen Yale students climb into a coffin, and tell their entire sex life to a room full of strangers.
lines.say: Every year, fifteen Yale students climb into a coffin, and tell their entire sex life to a room full of strangers.

lines.cap: It's Skull and Bones. A secret society at Yale since 1832. Their clubhouse is a windowless stone building they call the Tomb.
lines.say: It's Skull and Bones. A secret society at Yale since 1832. Their clubhouse is a windowless stone building they call the Tomb.

lines.cap: Members have included three presidents. Taft, and both Bushes.
lines.say: Members have included three presidents. Taft, and both Bushes.

lines.cap: In 2004, both men running for president, Bush and Kerry, were Bonesmen. Whoever won, the Tomb won.
lines.say: In 2004, both men running for president, Bush and Kerry, were Bonesmen. Whoever won, the Tomb won.

lines.cap: Reporters who dug into the club say new members lie in a coffin, and confess their sexual history. Out loud.
lines.say: Reporters who dug into the club say new members lie in a coffin, and confess their sexual history. Out loud.

lines.cap: Legend says members stole the skull of the Apache leader Geronimo. In 2009, his family actually sued them.
lines.say: Legend says members stole the skull of the Apache leader Geronimo. In 2009, his family actually sued them.

lines.cap: And the weirdest rule? If anyone says Skull and Bones near a member, he has to leave the room. So, want a Bonesman out of your party? Just say it.
